## What this review did not cover

## Worth fixing before opening

**2 · Testing · P2 · CONFIRMED (validator 90, refuter STANDS): the name builder can return a trailing space, so tests fail intermittently**
`src/domain/common/entities/name.builder.ts:24`
- **Problem:** `[...padded].slice(0, NAME_MAX_LENGTH)` cuts `faker.person.fullName()` to 30 characters without trimming afterwards.
- **Why names get that long:** faker's `en` full names include prefix and suffix variants (Mrs., Dr., III, PhD). About 23% of them can go past 30 characters.
- **The failure:** if the cut lands just after a space, the builder returns something like `"Mrs. Jacqueline Runolfsdottir "`. `NameSchema` trims it, so the stored value no longer equals the input.
- **Tests that break:**
  - `name.builder.spec.ts:18` (`sanitizeName(name)).toBe(name)`)
  - `spaces.controller.e2e-spec.ts:104-114` (`toEqual({ name: spaceName })`)
  - about 15 builders that use `.with('name', nameBuilder())`
- **No seed protects them:** faker is not seeded in `test/global-setup.ts`.
- **Introduced here:** the old `fromRegExp(/[a-zA-Z0-9]{12,30}/)` could never produce a space.
- **Fix:** add `.trim()` after the join, then re-pad to the minimum if the result got shorter than `NAME_MIN_LENGTH`.

## Worth a ticket or a decision

| # | Area · Priority | Location | Finding | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Security · P2 | `src/domain/common/schemas/name.schema.ts:16-19` | The allowlist accepts names that look blank or fake. I verified each by running the regex: `"ㅤㅤㅤ"` (U+3164 Hangul Filler is category Lo, so it looks empty), names made only of combining marks (`"\u0301\u0301\u0301"`), 1 letter plus 29 combining marks (zalgo text), punctuation only (`"---"`, `"@@@"`, `"..."`), and mixed-script lookalikes (`"Аnna"` with a Cyrillic А, or full-width `"Ａlice"`). The old regex required a letter or number at the start and between separators. Members and address-book contacts are shown to other people in the space, so blank-looking or lookalike names make impersonating a contact easier. Suggested fix: require at least one `\p{L}` or `\p{N}`, cap `\p{M}` per base character, and either reject U+3164, U+115F, U+1160 and U+FFA0 or apply NFKC. | Unadjudicated (proved by running the regex) |
| 3 | Regression · P2 | `src/domain/common/schemas/name.schema.ts:36-44` | Length errors used to come back with codes `too_small`, `too_big` and `invalid_format`. They now come back as `code: 'custom'`, and the minimum-length message changed to "character(s)". `ZodErrorFilter` (`src/routes/common/filters/zod-error.filter.ts:36-43`) sends the raw issue to clients, so any frontend or SDK that checks the code breaks without warning. No test in this repo still asserts the old codes. Either keep `.min`/`.max` after a `.pipe()`, or tell the web and mobile teams. | CONFIRMED, scope narrowed to external clients (validator PARTIAL 75, refuter STANDS) |
| 4 | Bugs · P3 | `src/domain/common/schemas/name.schema.ts:9,25` | Removing all `Cc` and `Cf` characters with nothing in their place joins words and corrupts some scripts. `"John\nDoe"` becomes `"JohnDoe"`. ZWNJ (U+200C) is needed in Persian and Indic spelling, so `"می‌خواهم"` gets changed. Suggested fix: replace `Cc` with a space and collapse repeated spaces; consider keeping U+200C and U+200D between letters. | Unadjudicated |
| 5 | Conventions · P3 | `src/domain/common/schemas/name.schema.ts:40` vs `:43` | The two length messages don't match: "at least N character(s)" vs "at most N characters". | Unadjudicated |
